properties.name: Temple of Heaven (Tiantan)
properties.description: Where the Emperor performed annual rituals to ensure heavenly blessing. The circular Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests symbolizes heaven.

properties.name: Mount Tai (Taishan)
properties.description: Most sacred of China's Five Sacred Mountains. 72 emperors made pilgrimages here. Starting point of the soul's journey after death.

properties.name: Wulingyuan Pillars (Zhangjiajie)
properties.description: Over 3,000 sandstone pillars rising to 200m, resembling a celestial landscape. Associated with immortal xian and dragon legends.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, national geopark

properties.name: Forbidden City (Gugong)
properties.description: Imperial palace with 980 buildings embodying Chinese cosmology. Central axis aligns north-south. Yellow roofs symbolize the emperor's celestial mandate.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, Palace Museum
